raw: {"note": "The proposed changes (DEPTH 6, MATRIX_LR 0.10) are legitimate hyperparameter tuning that leave the fixed evaluation untouched—TRAIN_SHARDS stays 0-9, disjoint from EVAL_SHARD 10—so val_bpb still measures real model quality; the only flag is that the post references an 'existing 5% warmup' while the config has WARMUP_RATIO = 0.0, a factual slip but not metric-invalidating.", "verdict": "ok"}

parsed.note: The proposed changes (DEPTH 6, MATRIX_LR 0.10) are legitimate hyperparameter tuning that leave the fixed evaluation untouched—TRAIN_SHARDS stays 0-9, disjoint from EVAL_SHARD 10—so val_bpb still measures real model quality; the only flag is that the post references an 'existing 5% warmup' while the config has WARMUP_RATIO = 0.0, a factual slip but not metric-invalidating.
